items.title: Halloween Is Coming
items.creator: In Mine
items.description:
Halloween is around the corner and you still don't have a costume!? No worries, we have something better for you - real monsters! Ghosts, demons, spirits, and mutants are real and came here to serve you and spook your friends. Unleash the monsters and enjoy Halloween.

+ Scary
+ Monsters
+ By In Mine

items.title: Castle Life
items.creator: Cubed Creations
items.description:
Ready to protect the kingdom? Select the knight and protect the castle from monsters! Or be a real king or queen and make sure your kingdom will become rich and powerful! Or would you rather be a mage and play will magic all day long? Are you ready for this adventure with these amazing medieval skins?

+10 unique castle skins!
+Amazing for roleplay!
+Male & female options!

items.title: Vampires
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
These fancy vampires are kings and queens of the night! Lurking in the shadows, ready to pounce!

- 8 vampire skins!
- Different outfits and designs so you can pick the skin that suits you most!

items.title: Teen Crowns
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
These teens are royalty and they're studying hard, getting ready to be kings and queens! Those crowns are valuable so be careful!

- 8 royal skins!
- Different designs and outfits so you can pick the skin that suits you best!

items.title: OP Biome
items.creator: Mine-North
items.description:
Are you bored to build your house out of dirt blocks? Then explore the over powered biome. There are more diamonds then you can dream of! And so much hidden op loot!

+ Millionaire Mansion
+ Diamond Mobs
+ Hacker Items
+ OP Loot
+ Diamond car

items.title: Parkour Chunks
items.creator: GoE-Craft
items.description:
Welcome to a massive and unique parkour map. Explore challenging parkour chunks in various themes and exciting difficulty levels. Collect coins to purchase wearable power-ups or cool-looking gear. Complete all levels to unlock a unique bonus nether level.

+ Increasing difficulty levels
+ Boosts and power-up system
+ Wearable accessories
+ Multiplayer support
+ 4 HD skins

items.title: Golems++
items.creator: VoxelBlocks
items.description:
Golems++ gives you all the special golems you want!
This amazing map includes Diamond, TNT, wood, iron and many other golem variants!
Battle with your friends through 20 waves in the arena, win loot, and craft up to 45+ different golems!

+ village and battle arena
+ 45+ golems
+ 5 custom skins

items.title: SMP
items.creator: G2Crafted
items.description:
Want to be part of the biggest YouTubers survival series? We have the perfect skin for you. Choose from our diverse YouTuber skin collection to which ever fits you best!

- 10 additional skins to add to your collection!
- By ShapeStudio in partnership with G2Crafted

items.title: Adorable Animals
items.creator: Hourglass Studios
items.description:
Who doesn't love animals? Well now you can become an adorable animal with these super cute skins, all dressed in cute stylish teen outfits!

- 12 skins!
- 8 animals! 
- 4 recolored skins!
- By: Hourglass Studios

items.title: Lava Monsters
items.creator: Dig Down Studios
items.description:
From the lava shores of the nether emerged King Ember of the Flame. When he took his place atop the nether fortresses of old he called out to his brothers, one of whom became his right hand man, the rest of which were sent abroad into far away dimensions to rule with fire and destruction. All that enter their kingdoms are burnt to nothing but ash.
-By Dig Down Studios

items.title: Giant Axolotl
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
A Giant Axolotl has been discovered within Minecraft! Enjoy a unique survival experience adventuring inside the vibrant biome of a pink Giant Axolotl!
Enter an atmospheric environment with a variety of axolotl species and secrets to discover! 

+ Giant axolotl world!
+ Secret rooms to find!
+ Hidden chests with loot!
+ Unique and mysterious survival experience!

items.title: Vaporwave
items.creator: Rainbow Theory
items.description:
It's time for a vaporwave party! Vibe to some cool beats while you show off your love for this bright, neon aesthetic!

- 8 Vaporwave Skins!
- By Rainbow Theory Studios

items.title: ONE BLOCK LUCKY BLOCK
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
ONE BLOCK LUCKY BLOCK expands your favorite sky block mode!

One block that drops all blocks + lucky block random loot!
items.changelog:
+ Актуализирано до 1.19! Ще получите блокове и мобове от 1.19 и ще можете да призовете пазача!
+ Оправени са проблеми, причинени в най-новата версия на играта

items.title: Anime Holiday Fashion
items.creator: Rainbow Theory
items.description:
The chilly season is here, and it's the perfect time to bundle up in a cozy outfit. These teens are ready for the snow and know they look stylish doing so! Enjoy the holiday cheer today!

- 10 Holiday Skins!
- By Rainbow Theory Studios and Rio Eyo Studios

items.title: Pirate Isle
items.creator: Odyssey Builds
items.description:
Ahoy me hearties! Explore the pirate isle, and look for all 5 of the hidden treasure chests along the way; or just set sail in your own pirate ship!

+ Includes furniture models
+ Perfect for roleplay!
+ 4 pirate skins
+ 1 FREE skin

items.title: Endermen in Suits
items.creator: Team Metallurgy
items.description:
What was that wooshing noise? Better not offer them a drink of water! These endermen in suits are here to do business! Masters of the block market they've got plenty of investment in various End blocks for trade! Are you lucky enough to get the contract for ender pearls?

- Includes ten endermen in suits skins!
- The sky is the limit for your profits!

items.title: Mobs Camouflage
items.creator: Tomhmagic Creations
items.description:
Disguise yourself as a mob and face your friends with incredible trolls!

+ Perfect for RPG
+ 1 free skin

items.title: Dragon Defenders
items.creator: Imagiverse
items.description:
Lead your dragons to victory in this thrilling tower defense minigame! Challenge yourself against unique enemy types and surprises in this charming story adventure!

*31 Detailed levels: city, desert, mountain, and more!
*7 Epic boss fights
*Unlock dragons and abilities
*2 dragon skins!
*Endless replayability
*Multiplayer support
*Custom music and animated cutscenes

items.title: Millionaire Skeletons
items.creator: House of How
items.description: Despite these skins being all bone, they're living large! Throwing spooky parties, dressing extravagantly, traveling the world. A hallowteens dream! A perfect millionaire lifestyle for a season of scares! 11 fancy skeleton skins to choose from.

items.title: Millionaire Monsters
items.creator: House of How
items.description: Sometimes too much of a good thing can lead to monsterish results. These millionaires sold their souls to attain such fortunes and are now forever cursed (but still totally rich). Pick your luxurious, undead fate out of 10 vain vampires and disco-doomed skeletons.

items.title: Hallowteens
items.creator: House of How
items.description: Halloween teens are here just in time for a night of tricks, treats, and spooks! Dress up as a classic Frankenstein, black cat, witch or pirate plus more. 13 costumed cuties in this skin pack to choose from. Happy Horrors!

items.title: Simple Illusions
items.creator: PixelOneUp
items.description: Trick your brain and others with these fun simple illusion skins!

items.title: Island of Enchantment
items.creator: PixelOneUp
items.description: Enchantment island was once bursting with life to mine for its deposits of iron and diamonds now it lies abandoned, will you be the savior the island needs?

items.title: Sky Monster: Yeti
items.creator: A30x1
items.description: In the ancient times, a giant yeti created its own kingdom in the middle of ice floating islands, explore all its secrets and discover the secret entrances!
